weaknesses: The abstract overstates the generalizability of the findings, suggesting that all LLMs are vulnerable to cipher attacks without sufficient empirical evidence.
The paper lacks a thorough discussion on the ethical implications of the proposed methods, particularly regarding the potential misuse of the techniques.
The experimental setup does not include a comprehensive range of LLMs beyond GPT-4 and Turbo, limiting the generalizability of the results.
The paper does not adequately address the limitations of the CipherChat framework, particularly in terms of its applicability to real-world scenarios.
strengths: The paper introduces a novel framework, CipherChat, which systematically explores the safety vulnerabilities of LLMs when interacting through ciphers.
Empirical results demonstrate significant findings regarding the ability of ciphers to bypass safety mechanisms in LLMs, highlighting an important area of research.
The study effectively identifies a 'secret cipher' capability within LLMs, contributing to the understanding of their underlying mechanisms.
The methodology is clearly articulated, allowing for reproducibility and further exploration by other researchers.
